The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 10251 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 25 June - the folder's feast day. Captioned Fevroniya and filed under Category:Febronia of Nisibis. The folder's own life places her city «Sivapol, care se afla in hotarele asirienilor» - inside the Assyrian borders - which is Nisibis under another name, so this is the same 4th-century virgin-martyr. The second plate of the day, 10252, is Peter and Fevronia of Murom, a Russian princely couple: that namesake was the trap here, and the day's first plate with the Nisibis category settles it. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
